firstRun.title: Get started
firstRun.description: A five-step walk through the essentials of your vault.

add.title: Add your first item
add.body: Use this button any time you want to save a login, note, or card.

search.title: Find things fast
search.body: Search is fuzzy — type a website, an email, or a tag.

generator.title: Generate strong passwords
generator.body: One click gives you a strong, unique password ready to paste.

workspace.title: Switch workspace
workspace.body: Personal, family, or work — everything you own lives in a separate workspace.

settings.title: Tune your account
settings.body: Security, sync, and preferences live here.

vaultBasics.title: Vault basics
vaultBasics.description: Add, find, and share items in your vault.

add.title: Add an item
add.body: Everything you save is encrypted on your device before it leaves.

search.title: Search your vault
search.body: Search runs locally on already-decrypted data — no server can see it.

share.title: Share safely
share.body: Share flows encrypt to the recipient's key — the server never sees plaintext.

sharing.title: Share an item
sharing.description: Send a login or note to someone with zero-knowledge encryption.

entry.title: Open Share
entry.body: Every item can be shared to a person or into a shared vault.

center.title: Sharing center
center.body: See who has what — revoke access with one click.

nav.title: Open Security
nav.body: Security bundles breach checks, weak passwords, and reuse warnings.

card.title: Security settings
card.body: Two-factor, recovery, and device management all live in one card.

remember.title: Persistent unlock
remember.body: Stay unlocked for 30 days on this device — sensitive actions still ask again.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Keep personal, family, and work items separate.

switcher.title: Switch workspaces
switcher.body: Each workspace has its own key and its own items.

people.title: Manage people
people.body: Invite family or coworkers and set who can see what.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Export, import, and backup live here — all client-side.

remember.title: Persistent unlock
remember.body: Balance convenience and safety by choosing how long we remember.

recovery.title: Recovery kit
recovery.body: Save your Secret Key somewhere safe — it's how you get back in if you forget.
